name: There's Blood in my Soup
source:
An evening at a hotpot restaurant goes awry, as Yuan Le discovers there’s more to her meal than meets the eye.

[From [url=https://jam-pudding-studio.itch.io/theres-blood-in-my-soup]itch.io[/url]]

火锅店里的一顿晚餐突生变故，袁乐赫然发现，自己碗里的这顿饭远没有表面看起来那么简单。
